additional_finding_not_previously_docume.description: defaultExec() in both gpt_send.mjs and gpt_watch.mjs called execFile(cliPath, args, {timeout, windowsHide:true}) directly on the npm .cmd shim path. On this Node/Windows combination that throws 'spawn EINVAL' unconditionally (Node now refuses to spawn .bat/.cmd files without an explicit shell - see Node's April 2024 batch-file command-injection CVE fix). This was invisible in the test suite because every existing test injects a fake exec; it would have made every real Sender/Watcher run fail immediately. Fixed by resolving the .cmd shim to the underlying node entry point it wraps (playwright.cmd's own body invokes `%dp0%\..\playwright\cli.js`) and spawning `node <entry> <args>` directly - a plain executable + argv array, no shell, no argument-escaping/injection risk. Verified against this live run.
